mapper.select: SELECT stop_id, stop_name, longitude, latitude FROM public.stops ORDER BY stop_id

WITH query_point AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint( CAST(#{longitude} AS double precision), CAST(#{latitude} AS double precision) ), 4326 )::geography AS point_geog )
SELECT s.stop_id, s.stop_name, s.longitude, s.latitude,
ST_Distance( s.geom::geography, query_point.point_geog ) AS distance_meters
FROM public.stops s
CROSS JOIN query_point
WHERE ST_DWithin( s.geom::geography, query_point.point_geog, CAST(#{radiusMeters} AS double precision) )
ORDER BY distance_meters, s.stop_id
